_comment: LTX-2.3 v1 shape menu (deepinfra). ONE landscape shape at 1080p/5s. CORRECTION (2026-06-19, measured): i2v is a SEPARATE compiled graph from t2v (it adds its own ~8 fx graphs; an earlier comment wrongly claimed i2v 'rides the same compiled shape' -- it does NOT). Both modes share the same shape_key (same WxH@frames -> same resident pool process), but each compiles its own graph, so 'warm_i2v': true makes eager warm-on-boot warm BOTH t2v and i2v per shape (otherwise the readiness gate lies and the first i2v request eats a cold recompile). 1080p-only is also required for VRAM: one resident process with both modes peaks ~119GB; a second resolution = a second resident process ~238GB > 180GB B200 -> OOM. Adding/removing shapes changes IMAGE_SHAPE_HASH and requires a new image tag + a matching per-model menu in backend ttv.py (CI-checked). Dims MUST be multiples of 64 (the LTX-2.3 two-stage refine requires h/w divisible by 64); we round UP so we never deliver fewer lines than advertised: 1080p -> 1920x1088 (1088=17*64, >=1080). 720p, 10s, and portrait deferred to a later menu. Compile-cache / boot-warm strategy: ltx23/CACHING.md.
